title: Dermal Filler in Ocala, FL | Lips & Cheeks | GLO Aesthetics
meta: Dermal filler in Ocala, FL restores volume in lips, cheeks and jawline with results that can last 6–18 months. Priced at your consult. Book at GLO today.
answer: Dermal filler is a hyaluronic-acid gel injection that restores lost volume, softens lines and enhances natural contours like lips, cheeks and jawline. It suits adults who want a refreshed look without surgery: treatment takes 30–45 minutes, results are visible right away with minimal downtime, and they last about 6–18 months. Results vary.
treats_intro: Dermal filler treats volume loss and contour concerns — hollow cheeks, temples and under-eyes, thin or uneven lips, nasolabial folds and a soft jawline or chin.
how: Hyaluronic-acid (HA) dermal filler is a smooth, cross-linked gel made from a sugar your skin already produces. Placed precisely beneath the skin, it adds volume and structure right away, and because HA attracts water it also helps the area look plumper and more hydrated. Your body gradually breaks the gel down over 6–18 months, depending on the product and area. Because it's HA, it can be dissolved with hyaluronidase if needed.
fit_h2: Is dermal filler right for me?
good_fit: You've noticed hollowing in your cheeks, temples or under-eyes
You'd like fuller, more balanced lips that still look like yours
You want softer nasolabial folds or a more defined jawline and chin
You want immediate results with minimal downtime
not_fit: You have an active skin infection, breakout or cold sore in the treatment area
You've had an allergic reaction to hyaluronic-acid filler or lidocaine
Your lines only show when you move your face — Xeomin or Daxxify is usually the better fit

faq_add.q: How long does dermal filler last?
faq_add.a: Hyaluronic-acid dermal filler typically lasts 6–18 months. How long yours lasts depends on the product, the area treated and your individual metabolism, and your provider will recommend when to schedule a touch-up.

faq_add.q: What should I avoid after dermal filler?
faq_add.a: For about 24 hours, skip strenuous exercise, alcohol and heavy pressure or massage on the treated area. Your provider will give you aftercare instructions; mild swelling or bruising usually settles within a few days.

faq_add.q: What's the difference between dermal filler and Xeomin?
faq_add.a: Dermal filler adds volume and structure to areas like lips, cheeks and jawline. Xeomin relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines, such as frown lines. Many people combine both, and your provider will recommend the right mix at your consultation.
